No CONFIG augmentation for `Token.rulerClass` exists anywhere in src/ — the funnel only covers document classes and data models, not canvas placeables. As a result, `TokenRuler.Implementation` stays typed as the base `TokenRuler` instance. The identical gap exists for Token5e (no `objectClass` wiring) so this is a consistent package-level omission rather than a unique ruler oversight, but it is still a real seam gap since the missing wiring means the typed subclass is never surfaced via the standard `Implementation` accessor. Severity left at medium.
